purpose: Teach: 主席/報復/紫外線/盗聴/衰え/反抗/自閉症/射撃

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者は主席で大学を卒業されたとのこと
lines.en: The suspect graduated top of their university class, according to the records.
lines.style: Measured, matter-of-fact delivery. Even cadence with a slight emphasis on the detail as fact. Professional but not cold—this is procedural information he's conveying clearly.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 警察、報復事件として捜査中ですね
lines.en: So the police are treating this as a retaliation case then?
lines.style: Thoughtful, seeking confirmation. Voice rises slightly at the end of the question. Quiet interest—he's processing, not judging. The tone of someone working through implications.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、現場の紫外線分析を進めております
lines.en: We're advancing the UV analysis of the scene right now.
lines.style: Direct, steady delivery. Slight emphasis on the procedural action. Professional distance maintained, but with the reassurance that work is actively moving forward.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、盗聴疑惑を警察、追及されたんですね
lines.en: So the police did pursue the wiretapping allegation in this case.
lines.style: Careful realization dawning. Quiet, as if he's piecing something together. Not accusatory—more like he's confirming his understanding with gentle certainty.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、衰えた記憶力の被害者にも丁寧に対応します
lines.en: We made sure to treat the victim with diminished memory capacity with the same care.
lines.style: Deliberate, emphasizing the word "care." Slight warmth beneath the professional tone—this is a point of integrity for him. Not defensive, but clear.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、反抗的な容疑者を警察、慎重に対応されたんですね
lines.en: And you handled the confrontational suspect with caution, as you should.
lines.style: Quiet approval. Respectful acknowledgment—he's recognizing something difficult that was done well. Slight nod in his voice, measured but genuine.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、自閉症の方への配慮も心がけております
lines.en: We also made a point to show consideration toward the individual with autism.
lines.style: Calm, genuine emphasis on the word "consideration." This isn't rote procedure—there's real care underneath. Patient, as if he's explaining something that matters to him.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、射撃事件として警察、捜査中ですね
lines.en: So this is being investigated as a shooting incident, then.
lines.style: Quiet statement, almost closing a thought. No question mark in the voice—more a confirmation to himself. Weary, as if the full picture has finally settled.
